claim: The six-path frozen repair closes the two predecessor source counterexamples under the unchanged selected Q1/Q4 contract and preserves unaffected prior support within its original scope.

closedCounterexamples.rootTriage: Root retained S2 and selected bounded repair; no P priority is assigned here.
closedCounterexamples.question: Can a required declared sharing-peer slot with no occurrence disappear into an eligible observed subset?
closedCounterexamples.conclusion: No in the repaired owner path. admittedPeerSelections initializes every declared peer slot, retains all authenticated occurrences under that slot, and returns empty selections for never-opened or opened-but-unstarted slots. Validator still compares observed peer identities, then refuses absent/empty required slots. Dispatch and replay both supply this per-slot shape.
sourceReasoning: peerSlots meaning is unchanged: other same-plan slots sharing a coverage criterion. Unrelated plan slots are not added to the prerequisite.
The collector can no longer erase a missing slot: bySlot is initialized from the complete required slotRefs and the returned array is mapped from those same refs.

Known same-family or unresolved admitted occurrences stay ineligible/unknown before the missing-slot check; either result is non-dispatchable. A populated proper subset now yields required_peer_missing.
The existing nominal call-bound gate and binding/start order are unchanged.
Replay constructs one entry for each declared peer slot, with its selected J identity or an empty selection. All consumers of the changed decision input in this cone were inspected.
closedCounterexamples.testAssessment: New owner and actual actor-gate assertions cover a never-opened peer, an opened-but-unstarted peer, all-missing peers and one missing among two. The refusal helper checks the exact refusal, unchanged prefix, no binding/start transaction and zero process-start marker entries. Complete conditional peer evidence, author_distinct and ordinary work controls remain. Existing assertions were not removed.
closedCounterexamples.sunnyDayImpact: The selected author_distinct/ordinary path is preserved. A fresh peer-required plan now truthfully refuses its first slot until a separately selected owner relation can supply prior authenticated peer evidence. TASK explicitly retains that production route as an open dependency; this repair does not make it constructable.
closedCounterexamples.revisingObservation: A valid required sharing slot omitted from the supplied per-slot population, or a missing slot reaching binding/start under authentic owner input, would falsify this closure.

closedCounterexamples.rootTriage: Root separately priced the original Q1 trigger/harm as S3 while preserving Reviewer S2; this recheck does not relabel the prior severity or assign P priority.
closedCounterexamples.question: Does the supported prompt-option operand alone establish a model, and can consumers accept that false established identity?
closedCounterexamples.conclusion: No in the selected supported owner grammar. The scanner consumes the next argument of the declared value-bearing option as data. The original --append-system-prompt / --model=claude-opus-5-5 input now has no model selector and derives unknown. Correspondence and event admission use that corrected derivation, and the actual qualification gate refuses it.
sourceReasoning: Known owner-composed operand options and zero-operand flags are declared privately alongside the existing model grammar; no identity type, family policy, unknown-reason set or event-profile descriptor changed.
The original inline and separated selector-shaped operand cases remain data. An actual model selector after the consumed operand still establishes its own argument coordinate.
A selector immediately after an option outside the grammar, or after the -- terminator, remains unknown rather than being assumed to select the model.
worker_transport preparation, immutable captured selection, c_call correspondence and event_store consumers are unchanged and continue to call the one derivation/correspondence owner.
closedCounterexamples.testAssessment: A new transport test covers operand-only inline/separated forms, forged established-identity correspondence refusal, the actor owner composition with a real selector, ordinary argument controls, and nearby unknown-arity/end-of-options negatives. Added event-store and actual gate assertions cover the original false identity. No test/assertion removal or skip/todo addition was found.
closedCounterexamples.sunnyDayImpact: Normal explicit model selection and the selected actor composition remain available. Selector-shaped prompt data alone stays unknown. The review makes no live CLI/provider/default-model assertion.
closedCounterexamples.revisingObservation: A concrete supported owner-composed option/operand shape that still produces a false established model, or a changed CLI/owner arity contract, invalidates this bounded closure.

No such supported owner-composed option or concrete causal path was established in the frozen cone. The named supported-operand counterexample and nearby ambiguous forms are repaired. This result is not certification of arbitrary CLI options; no generic grammar/hardening campaign is selected.

The first slot of a fresh author_and_peer_distinct plan lacks prior authenticated peer evidence and now refuses. No owner relation in this increment supplies it before the peer start. The selected repair requires truthful refusal, not a new peer-planning or routing mechanism; production-positive peer eligibility remains open.

No new executed complete multi-peer-plan test through resolveQualificationAssessments is provided. Static inspection confirms replay supplies every required slot in the new shape; existing reported warm/cold single-slot J readback negatives remain. No complete-peer replay execution claim is made.

The two-peer fixture shares separate criterionRefs with the assessor so each criterion has distinct published actors. Admitted author/peer antecedents and physical/journal/terminal premises remain synthetic. These test the selected owner relation and gate under explicit premises; they do not establish production peer creation, physical admission or a completed successful qualification receipt.
